en.t: From now on, I shall certainly repay your great kindness."

units.source_text: 皇上笑道：“你说今后报恩，怕靠不住吧。

en.t: The Emperor laughed and said, "You say you will repay my kindness from now on, but I am afraid that cannot be relied upon.

units.source_text: 如果有人说我不该向你求爱，我倒要同他评评道理看。”

en.t: If anyone says I ought not to court you, I would like to argue the rights and wrongs of it with him."
As he spoke, his face was full of resentment.

units.source_text: 玉鬘实在无法对付，觉得讨厌之极。

en.t: Tamakazura truly had no way to deal with him and found him utterly repellent.

units.source_text: 她想：“今后在他面前，决不可和颜悦色了。

en.t: She thought, "From now on, I must never show him a gentle or pleasant face.

units.source_text: 世间男子都有此种恶癖，真可恶啊！”

en.t: Men in this world all have this vile habit; how hateful they are!"
So she set her face sternly.

units.source_text: 冷泉帝也不便随意调戏她，想道：“日后慢慢会熟悉的。”

en.t: Emperor Reizei also could not tease her as he pleased, and thought, "In time, she will gradually grow used to it."
